LibTmux.Query.Client

Description

Captured tmux client fields for LibTmux.Query.

Client means an observed tmux client, not the operational Server handle. The tmux 3.3a baseline captures attached clients. tty can be absent for a control client; bytes retain endpoint path semantics.
